title: 竜胆 Rindō
caption: Dark Japanese noir instrumental. Breathy shakuhachi bamboo flute lead and plucked koto over a slow walking upright bass, soft brushed drums and low sparse piano chords, a distant taiko drum hit now and then. Ominous, dignified, a yakuza film at night. Warm analog recording with deep reverb. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
